notes: Brown tourist direction signs at a junction in Kutini-Payamu (Iron Range) National Park, Cape York, Queensland (camera -12.7454, 143.2812): top panel with up arrow and cockatoo pictogram 'HISTORICAL SITE / PORTLAND ROADS', middle panel with right arrow 'WWII HISTORICAL SITE / IRON RANGE AIRPORT', lower chevron sign 'WW II GORDON STRIP' with a blue 'INFORMATION BAY' strip. Bullet dents, faint graffiti scrawl across the middle panel, a '51 FNQR' sticker and a small green arrow plate are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
